column1: # email acceptance vectors, from the RFC 5321 Mailbox grammar.
# The vendored is_email corpus (testdata/corpus/isemail) grades 164 addresses
# against the RFC 5322 spectrum, and the official suite's
# optional/format/email.json carries the dot-atom and address-literal rules.
# What both leave open is the dotless single-label domain, which Domain permits
# and the RFC 1123 numeric-TLD ban does not reach, and the empty quoted local
# part below.
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.
user@example.com
john.doe@example.org
a@b.co
column3: sub-domain = Let-dig [Ldh-str], so one octet is a label

column1: a@b
column3: Domain needs no dot; the RFC 1123 numeric-TLD ban is hostname's

column1: not-an-email
column3: Mailbox has no production without the "@"

column1: @example.com
column3: Local-part is a Dot-string or a Quoted-string, never empty

column1: user@
user@@example.com
column3: @ is not an atext character, so it cannot open a Domain

column1: # RFC 5321 Quoted-string = DQUOTE *QcontentSMTP DQUOTE permits zero content
# characters, and both drafts define the format by grammar conformance rather
# than by deliverability. e9372c3 rejected the empty quoted local part and
# 16d9020 restored it; this row is why the question does not reopen.
\\"@example.com"
column3: the empty quoted local part (e9372c3, then 16d9020)

column1: \@example.com"
column3: an unterminated quoted local part stays malformed
